svg.text: Draw a track. Keep the rider on the sled to reach the goal.
Pencil draws a stroke. Line previews a straight segment.
Erase removes lines. Pan drags the view. Start / Goal place flags.
Edit / Play selects mode. Run / Pause controls playback.
Drag the timeline to pause at a frame. Edit to update that frame.
1-6 tools Z undo Y redo Arrows pan G grid + snap
H home F fit track S save slot L load slot
Track > Save track code gives a compact code you can copy.
Load track code restores it. Save slot stays inside the project.
Play has a fullscreen button to hide the editor. Tap to close.
